notes.title: Fix Crelate poller auth: read CRELATE_API_KEY env var, drop proxy assumption
notes.raw_title: Fix Crelate poller auth: read CRELATE_API_KEY env var, drop proxy assumption
notes.summary: The Crelate poller was hitting HTTP 401 on every request in production because it assumed an HTTPS_PROXY-injected credential (the Perplexity sandbox pattern). Render doesn't have that shim, so fetch() went out with no auth at all.
notes.author: vectordev2001
